name: Walkman cassette custody and audiobook queue - native qualification pending

steps._note: NOT RUN. This observation capture is not a passing feature test. Verify exact item metadata/count conservation on Use/Insert/Return,24 separate audio slots, initial remote snapshot Use, double-click and duplicate offer/ACK, stale revision, full bag, save faults and reload. Canceled physical reading with failed checkpoint must freeze its exact fraction, clear HUD once, retry save once per second without repeated cancellation messages, and preserve progress for later study. Physical reading completion save failure must retain pending result, retry at one-second intervals without reapplying study, refuse title/media switches, avoid recreating partial fraction, and report success once after save. Completion advances once after durable save; failed completion save retries without awarding twice; completed-only queue remains idle. Repeat single-player, listen host, remote and dedicated clients.
